$sources: EN 1991-1-1:2002 Sec 6.3, Tables 6.1-6.2 (categories A-D), 6.3-6.4 (E), 6.7-6.8 (F, G), 6.9-6.10 (H, I), recommended values
EN 1991-1-1 Sec 6.4, Table 6.12 and Annex B: barriers and vehicle barriers
source: EN 1991-1-1 Sec 6.3, Tables 6.1-6.10 (the recommended values; the National Annex may choose others in the ranges of Table 6.2). The ids are SAEngine's area uses; each row names its category.

residential.name: Category A: rooms of residential buildings and houses

residentialPublic.name: Category A: bedrooms of hotels and hostels

classroom.name: Category C1: areas with tables (schools, cafés, restaurants, reception rooms)

dining.name: Category C1: dining rooms and restaurants

assemblyFixed.name: Category C2: areas with fixed seats (churches, theatres, cinemas, lecture halls)

assemblyMovable.name: Category C3: areas without obstacles for moving people (museums, exhibition rooms, access areas of public buildings)

corridorAbove.name: Category C3: corridors and access areas of public and administration buildings

officeLobby.name: Category C3: lobbies and access areas

danceHall.name: Category C4: areas for physical activities (dance halls, gymnastic rooms, stages)

grandstand.name: Category C5: areas for large crowds (concert halls, sports halls with stands, terraces)

retailGround.name: Category D1: areas in general retail shops

retailUpper.name: Category D1: areas in general retail shops

wholesale.name: Category D2: areas in department stores

storageLight.name: Category E1: areas for storage, including access areas

storageHeavy.name: Category E1: areas for storage (heavier storage by the actual use)

libraryStacks.name: Category E1: library stacks and archives

parking.name: Category F: traffic and parking areas for light vehicles (≤ 30 kN gross)

driveway.name: Category G: traffic and parking areas for medium vehicles (30-160 kN gross)

roof.name: Category H: roofs not accessible except for normal maintenance and repair

roofGarden.name: Category I: roofs accessible with occupancy of categories A-D (taken as C1)

terrace.name: Category I: accessible roofs and terraces (taken as A balconies)

roofLive.name: Category H: roofs not accessible except for maintenance

rows.name: Category A: barriers and partition walls (line load at 1.2 m at most)
Categories C2 to C4 and D
Vehicle barriers, vehicles up to 2500 kg (F = 0.5 m v²/(δc + δb), m 1500 kg, v 4.5 m/s, δc 100 mm, rigid barrier)

sources.uses: EN 1991-1-1 Tables 6.1, 6.2 (A-D), 6.3, 6.4 (E1: qk 7.5, Qk 7.0), 6.7, 6.8 (F: qk 2.5 (1.5-2.5), Qk 20 (10-20); G: qk 5.0, Qk 90 (40-90)), 6.9, 6.10 (H: qk 0.4, Qk 1.0; I by the category of use); recommended (underlined) values
sources.concentratedPatch: EN 1991-1-1 Sec 6.3.1.2(4): Qk on a square of 50 mm side (A-D); F on 100 mm squares per wheel, G on 200 mm (Sec 6.3.3.2(4))
sources.partitions: EN 1991-1-1 Sec 6.3.1.2(8): movable partitions of self-weight ≤ 1.0 kN/m: 0.5 kN/m², ≤ 2.0 kN/m: 0.8 kN/m², ≤ 3.0 kN/m: 1.2 kN/m² (as 0.4 per kN/m, at least 0.5: 1.0-2.0 kN/m in between get less than the step value); heavier partitions are dead load on their own lines
sources.roofLive: EN 1991-1-1 Table 6.10, category H: qk 0.4 kN/m² (0.0-1.0), Qk 1.0 kN (0.9-1.5), recommended; not combined with snow or wind (Sec 3.3.2(1))
sources.barriers: EN 1991-1-1 Sec 6.4, Table 6.12 (qk on barriers, recommended values); Annex B (informative): vehicle barriers in car parks, F at 375 mm over 1.5 m, ramps 0.5 F at 610 mm, twice that opposite straight ramps over 20 m
